interpretation.T30_T5_models: Footbreak and Crown graded model predictions
interpretation.initial: Odds Radar true external opening market benchmark
interpretation.not_available: No immutable as-of-opening team-feature model predictions exist; therefore no historical trained opening model is claimed.

definition.pick: lower decimal-odds side on the unique paired main line
definition.role: market benchmark, not a trained prediction model
definition.settlement: Asian quarter-line returns; COU requires hkjc_official corner total

definition.decision_stage: T5 because the full path is only known at T5
definition.direction: lower decimal-odds side at each stage
definition.path: initial direction → T30 direction → T5 direction
definition.promotion_rule: at least 30 full observations, at least 10 holdout observations, positive discovery and holdout ROI, and holdout ROI 95% lower bound above zero
definition.settlement: T5 side, line and decimal odds
definition.validation: chronological 70/30 split within each fixed path

definition.canonical_snapshot: latest unreconciled pre-kickoff snapshot per fixture-stage
definition.dedupe: exactly one unambiguous target per fixture-market-stage
definition.legacy_initial: excluded because 首預 lead time is not fixed
definition.settlement: stored grade target mapped to Asian quarter-line unit return

statistical_notes: Wilson intervals describe hit-rate uncertainty only.
ROI intervals use deterministic fixture-level bootstrap resampling.
Stage variants are exploratory and are not independent confirmations.
A positive point estimate is not promoted when its 95% ROI interval crosses zero.
